title: Путешествие на Запад: Безумный король 2
alt: Journey to the West: The Mad King 2 / Westward: Asura 2
description: Season 2 of Asura picks up where Season 1 left off, plunging straight into an all-out war between Asura and the gods. Standing alone against the world, Asura unleashes his fury, shatters the laws of Heaven, and slaughters the gods above! (Source: WeTV)

en:
Season 2 of Asura picks up where Season 1 left off, plunging straight into an all-out war between Asura and the gods. Standing alone against the world, Asura unleashes his fury, shatters the laws of Heaven, and slaughters the gods above!

(Source: WeTV)
